findings.claim: GE 10-K FY2025 風險段揭露：公司對部分最大客戶有重大業務與信用曝險，且業界活動受少數大型 OEM 與大型航空公司影響；未在該段列出單一客戶占營收百分比。
findings.excerpt: Activity in our sector is also particularly influenced by the actions of a small group of large original equipment manufacturers, as well as large airlines in various geographies. We have significant business with, and credit exposure to, some of our largest customers

findings.claim: GE 2026 年第三季財報新聞稿：依年初至今表現與第四季展望上調全公司指引。
findings.excerpt: Year-to-date orders, revenue and total engine deliveries up over 20%, raising full-year guidance Third Quarter 2026: •Total orders of $19.0B, +49%; •Total revenue (GAAP) of $14.1B, +16%;

note: 搜尋未找到 GE 自身 10-K 列出的單一客戶營收占比，也未找到 2026 年特定大客戶破產或降評的來源；Q3 2026 財報新聞稿搜尋摘要顯示全公司指引上調，未讀原文故僅列線索。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
